description: Notelm v2.0 — Achieve 80%+ NotebookLM UX parity with tags, global search, export, suggested questions, summaries, conversation titles, and keyboard shortcuts

userStories.title: Extend notebook and chat metadata schemas
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to store tags on notebooks and title/pinned on conversations so frontend features can persist these values.
acceptanceCriteria: Add tags: List[str] with default [] to notebook metadata schema in backend/app/models/schemas.py
Add title: Optional[str] and pinned: bool fields to chat-related schemas
Update notebook create/update endpoints to accept and persist tags
Update frontend TypeScript types in frontend/src/types/index.ts to include new fields
Python imports succeed: python -c 'from app.models.schemas import NotebookResponse'
TypeScript compilation passes: cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit
userStories.notes: Schema extended with tags, title, pinned. ChatMessage model added.

userStories.title: Create global search index in ChromaDB
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a global ChromaDB collection indexing documents across all notebooks for cross-notebook search functionality.
acceptanceCriteria: Create global_search ChromaDB collection in backend/app/database.py on app startup
Add documents to global index on upload with notebook_id metadata
Remove documents from global index when deleted
Add startup migration that re-indexes all existing documents into global_search
Python imports succeed and app starts without errors
userStories.notes: Global search index with startup migration, add/remove on document upload/delete

userStories.title: Tag management API endpoints
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I need CRUD API endpoints for notebook tags so users can create, list, filter, and delete tags.
acceptanceCriteria: PATCH /api/notebooks/{id} accepts tags in request body and persists to metadata
GET /api/notebooks supports ?tag=xxx query param to filter by tag
GET /api/tags returns deduplicated list of all unique tags across all notebooks
DELETE /api/tags/{name} removes the specified tag from all notebooks
Each endpoint returns proper error responses for invalid input (400) and not found (404)
Tags persist across app restarts
userStories.notes: Tag filtering, list tags, and delete tag endpoints added to notebooks router

userStories.title: Global search API endpoint
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I need an API that searches across all notebooks and returns results with notebook context.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/search?q=xxx queries the global_search ChromaDB collection
Each result includes: snippet, source, notebook_id, notebook_name
Results deduplicated by chunk content
Returns empty array when query is empty or no results found
Response time under 2 seconds
userStories.notes: SearchResult schema, query_global() in database.py, search router registered

userStories.title: Export conversation API
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I need an API that exports a notebook conversation history as formatted Markdown for download.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/chat/export/{notebook_id} returns Markdown string with all messages
Markdown includes: notebook name as title, date, role labels, citations as footnotes
Response header Content-Disposition: attachment
Returns 404 if notebook has no conversations
Backend starts without errors

userStories.title: Export notebook API (ZIP package)
userStories.description: As a user, I want to export an entire notebook as a downloadable ZIP package containing documents, conversations, and metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/notebooks/{id}/export returns a ZIP file via StreamingResponse
ZIP contains: README.md, conversation.md, metadata.json, documents/ folder
Use Python zipfile stdlib, no temp files on disk
Proper Content-Disposition header
Returns 404 if notebook not found

userStories.title: Suggested questions API
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I need a configurable API that uses LLM to generate relevant starter questions based on notebook documents.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/chat/suggested-questions accepts {notebook_id} and returns 3-5 questions
Questions are contextually relevant to uploaded documents
Returns generic starter questions when no documents uploaded
Accepts optional count param (default 4, min 1, max 8)
Backend starts without errors

userStories.title: Summary generation API (document + notebook)
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I need APIs to generate document-level and notebook-level summaries using LLM with caching.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/documents/{doc_id}/summarize generates summary of a single document
POST /api/notebooks/{notebook_id}/summarize generates overview of all documents
Both endpoints cache summaries and return cached version if exists
Cache invalidated when document content changes
Returns proper error when not found (404)

userStories.title: Auto-generate conversation titles
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the backend to auto-generate a title for each conversation from the first user message.
acceptanceCriteria: When first user message is sent, backend auto-generates a title
Default: smart truncation of first 50 chars at word boundary
Title stored in conversation metadata
PATCH /api/notebooks/{id}/conversation/{conv_id}/title allows manual edit
Backend starts without errors

userStories.title: Tag management UI in sidebar
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see, add, and filter tags on notebooks in the sidebar so I can organize my work.
acceptanceCriteria: Each notebook shows tags as colored chips below its name
Add tag with inline input and autocomplete from existing tags
Click tag chip to filter sidebar to notebooks with that tag
Clear filter with x button or All Notebooks option
Empty state when no notebooks match selected tag
TypeScript compilation passes

userStories.title: Global search UI with keyboard shortcut
userStories.description: As a user, I want a Ctrl+K search bar that finds content across all my notebooks.
acceptanceCriteria: Search bar triggered by Ctrl+K keyboard shortcut
Debounced search (300ms) against GET /api/search
Results show: snippet, document name, notebook name
Clicking result navigates to that notebook
Loading spinner and no results empty state
TypeScript compilation passes

userStories.title: Export conversation button in ChatPanel
userStories.description: As a user, I want to export the current conversation as Markdown with one click.
acceptanceCriteria: Export button (download icon) in ChatPanel header
Click triggers download of Markdown file
Toast notification on success and error
Button disabled when conversation is empty
TypeScript compilation passes

userStories.title: Export notebook button in Sidebar
userStories.description: As a user, I want to export an entire notebook as a ZIP package from the sidebar.
acceptanceCriteria: Export option in notebook context menu
Click triggers download of ZIP file
Toast notification with progress and success/error states
TypeScript compilation passes

userStories.title: Suggested questions panel in chat area
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see AI-generated suggested questions when I open a notebook.
acceptanceCriteria: Show suggested questions as clickable chips when chat is empty
Clicking a question sends it as user message
Questions disappear after first message sent
Refresh button to regenerate questions
Loading skeleton while generating
TypeScript compilation passes

userStories.title: Summary display cards for documents and notebooks
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see AI-generated summaries for documents and notebook overviews.
acceptanceCriteria: Expandable summary section on each document in SourcePanel
Notebook summary card in chat area when empty
Generate Summary button with loading state
Summary persists on revisit (cached)
Regenerate button to refresh
TypeScript compilation passes

userStories.title: Conversation history panel with auto-titles
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my conversation history with auto-generated titles and switch between conversations.
acceptanceCriteria: Conversation history panel showing past conversations with titles
Each entry shows title, date, message count
Click to switch conversation, current one highlighted
Pin/unpin and delete buttons on each conversation
New Conversation button to start fresh
Empty state for no conversations
TypeScript compilation passes

userStories.title: Keyboard shortcuts system
userStories.description: As a power user, I want keyboard shortcuts for common actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Ctrl+K: Open global search
Ctrl+J: New conversation
Ctrl+E: Export current conversation
Ctrl+N: New notebook
Ctrl+,: Open settings
?: Show keyboard shortcuts help dialog
Shortcuts not active when typing in input/textarea
TypeScript compilation passes

userStories.title: Settings panel — AI feature toggles
userStories.description: As a user, I want to enable/disable LLM-powered features to control API costs.
acceptanceCriteria: New AI Features section in SettingsDialog
Toggles for: Suggested Questions, Auto Summaries, Smart Titles
Toggles saved to localStorage
UI respects toggle state without page refresh
Each toggle shows estimated token cost
Existing settings continue to work unchanged
TypeScript compilation passes
